gaps: The battery is removed in step 3 but the page does not say what kind it is, so no battery part is listed.
The teardown's linked user manual is for model 595 / 657550, not the 581, so it is not used.
method: The iFixit teardown names the Roomba 581.
It shows the main board, cliff sensors, IR bump, caster detection piece, speaker and DC barrel jack, with step numbers and asterisk-marked screws.
Qty, ext and obs are editorial ratings.

comps.spec: Main board, removed at step 14; held by five asterisk-marked screws.
IR bump, held by two asterisk-marked screws (step 10); three wires connect it to the main board through a connector (steps 6 and 9).
Caster detection piece, held by two asterisk-marked screws on top; its LED plastic is secured by one asterisk-marked screw (step 16).
Speaker, held by one asterisk-marked screw (step 13).
DC barrel jack, held by one asterisk-marked screw (step 13).
